package notificationcompletion_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	server "example.com/notificationcompletion/gen/jsonrpc/probe/server"
	probe "example.com/notificationcompletion/gen/probe"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
	transport "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/observability/transport"
)

type (
	completionService struct {
		calls  atomic.Int64
		frames chan struct{}
	}
	completionEvents struct {
		sync.Mutex
		values []transport.Event
	}
)

func TestNotificationFailureKeepsConnection(t *testing.T) {
	for _, method := range []string{"unary", "server", "bidi", "required"} {
		for _, mode := range []string{"decode-notification", "decode-request", "null-request", "endpoint-notification", "success-notification"} {
			if method == "required" && (mode == "endpoint-notification" || mode == "success-notification") {
				continue
			}
			t.Run(method+"/"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
				svc := &completionService{frames: make(chan struct{}, 4)}
				events := &completionEvents{}
				mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
				server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.HandleStream, probe.NewEndpoints(svc), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, &websocket.Upgrader{}, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{}))
				hs := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
					mux.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(transport.WithObserver(r.Context(), transport.ObserverFunc(events.record))))
				}))
				defer hs.Close()
				conn, response, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws"+strings.TrimPrefix(hs.URL, "http")+"/ws", nil)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
				defer func() {
					require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
				}()
				require.NoError(t, conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(3*time.Second)))
				params := `{"value":123}`
				id := ""
				switch mode {
				case "decode-request":
					id = `,"id":"bad"`
				case "null-request":
					id = `,"id":null`
				case "endpoint-notification":
					params = `{"value":"fail"}`
				case "success-notification":
					params = `{"value":"ignored"}`
				}
				if method == "required" {
					params = `{"value":"valid"}`
					if mode == "decode-request" {
						params = `{"value":123}`
					}
				}
				first := `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"` + method + `","params":` + params + id + `}`
				require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(first)))
				require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"unary","params":{"value":"barrier"},"id":"barrier"}`)))
				if id != "" {
					var failure jsonrpc.RawResponse
					require.NoError(t, conn.ReadJSON(&failure))
					require.NotNil(t, failure.Error)
					require.Equal(t, int(jsonrpc.InvalidParams), failure.Error.Code)
					require.NotEmpty(t, failure.Error.Message)
					if mode == "null-request" {
						require.Nil(t, failure.ID)
					} else {
						require.Equal(t, "bad", failure.ID)
					}
				}
				var barrier jsonrpc.RawResponse
				require.NoError(t, conn.ReadJSON(&barrier), "request-local failure must not terminate the connection")
				require.Equal(t, "barrier", barrier.ID)
				require.Nil(t, barrier.Error)
				require.JSONEq(t, `"barrier"`, string(barrier.Result))
				for range 2 {
					select {
					case <-svc.frames:
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Fatal("request observation did not complete")
					}
				}
				wantCalls := int64(1)
				if mode == "endpoint-notification" || mode == "success-notification" {
					wantCalls++
				}
				require.Equal(t, wantCalls, svc.calls.Load())
				if mode == "decode-notification" || mode == "decode-request" || mode == "null-request" {
					require.Equal(t, transport.ReasonInvalidJSONRPCParams, events.firstFailure())
					require.False(t, events.hasSuppressedStreamClose(), "request rejection is not service-stream completion")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func (s *completionService) HandleStream(ctx context.Context, stream probe.Stream) error {
	for {
		observer := transport.BeginRequest(ctx, transport.TransportJSONRPC, "probe", "frame")
		err := stream.Recv(transport.WithRequestObserver(ctx, observer))
		observer.End()
		select {
		case s.frames <- struct{}{}:
		default:
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}

func (s *completionService) Unary(_ context.Context, p *probe.Input) (string, error) {
	s.calls.Add(1)
	if p.Value == "fail" {
		return "", errors.New("service failed")
	}
	return p.Value, nil
}

func (s *completionService) Server(ctx context.Context, p *probe.Input, stream probe.ServerServerStream) error {
	value, err := s.Unary(ctx, p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return stream.SendResponse(ctx, value)
}

func (s *completionService) Bidi(ctx context.Context, p *probe.Input, stream probe.BidiServerStream) error {
	value, err := s.Unary(ctx, p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return stream.SendResponse(ctx, value)
}

func (s *completionService) Required(ctx context.Context, p *probe.InputRequiredPayload, stream probe.RequiredServerStream) error {
	value, err := s.Unary(ctx, &probe.Input{ID: &p.ID, Value: p.Value})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return stream.SendResponse(ctx, value)
}

func (r *completionEvents) record(_ context.Context, event transport.Event) {
	r.Lock()
	defer r.Unlock()
	r.values = append(r.values, event)
}

func (r *completionEvents) firstFailure() transport.Reason {
	r.Lock()
	defer r.Unlock()
	for _, event := range r.values {
		if event.Kind == transport.EventKindRequestFailure {
			return event.Reason
		}
	}
	return transport.ReasonOK
}

func (r *completionEvents) hasSuppressedStreamClose() bool {
	r.Lock()
	defer r.Unlock()
	for _, event := range r.values {
		if event.Reason == transport.ReasonStreamFinalResponseSuppressed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
